title: DEPHYRIER Ref Saerorun (Refs Reload Discipline)
style: tooling-doctrine pulse 104 bpm trilingual EN KO FR DEPHYRIER signature workflow-rules credits-delta-truth terminal-pulse spoken-korean ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Refs change on reload re-find at the start
form_input not type for the lyric heart
browser_batch the sequence not one tool at a time
The lane that runs deep needs the rhythm to rhyme

[Pre-Chorus — Korean romanization]
Ref saerorun jaegeomsaek peilo
(Refs new re-search payload)
Ip-pakji aninae form-input chajja
(Not type but find form-input)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER refs reload form_input batch
Ref saerorun browser-batch hamkke
(Refs new browser-batch together)
Les refs se renouvellent batch ensemble
(The refs renew batch together)

[Verse 2]
Credits delta is the ground truth not the visible row
Virtualization hides the rest below the show
Fifty credits per batch the math holds clean
Subtraction is the proof of what was seen

[Bridge — French]
Le débit des crédits est la vérité
(The credit drain is the truth)
La rangée visible peut mentir coté
(The visible row can lie aside)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER credits delta is the proof
Ref saerorun cincuenta créditos
DEPHYRIER cinquante crédits par lot
